description: DESTRUCTIVE. Delete ONE epic, feature, user story, defect or task. `ref` is the item's NAME, business key (EP_12, FT_3, US_5, DF_7 …) or numeric id — resolved here, the user never supplies an internal id. TWO-STEP: call WITHOUT `confirm` to get a preview (what will be deleted + anything that depends on it); show it to the user and ASK; only then call again with `confirm:true`. An item that still has dependents (an epic with features/stories, a feature/story with children or test cases, a defect with test cases/tasks) is REFUSED with the blockers listed — nothing cascades. An ambiguous name lists the matches and deletes nothing. Needs the user's delete permission; no agent required. Requires a live connection.

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after the user has seen the preview and explicitly confirmed the delete.

kind.description: Which kind of item to delete.

ref.description: Name, business key (EP_/FT_/US_/DF_…) or numeric id of the item.

name: backlog_delete
title: Delete an epic / feature / user story / defect / task
